required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

## Summary

The spec requires rejecting owner creation with a 400 and a JSON `{"errors": [...]}` body naming each missing/blank required field. I implemented this in **one new, self-contained file** — `OwnerRequiredFieldsAdvice.java` — touching no existing code, which keeps structural impact minimal.

**How it works:**
- It's a `@ControllerAdvice` implementing `RequestBodyAdvice`. Its `afterBodyRead` hook fires only for `OwnerFieldsDto` bodies (the `POST /api/owners` create payload), runs *before* Bean Validation, and collects any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone` that are null or blank (`isBlank()` catches whitespace-only values, which the generated `@Size(min=1)` annotations miss).
- If any are missing it throws a small nested `MissingOwnerFieldsException`, and a co-located `@ExceptionHandler` in the same class returns `400` with `{"errors": [...field names...]}`.
- `@Order(HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE)` ensures its exception handler wins over the existing broad `Exception.class` handler in `ExceptionControllerAdvice` (without it, the missing-field exception was being reported as a 500).

**Why this keeps the cost low:** every changed function lives inside one new, tiny cohesive class, so `WMC_other` (surrounding complexity) is near zero, each function has CC 1, and only a single file is touched — versus editing `OwnerRestControllerV1` (a large, high-WMC class) or the shared exception advice.

Running whitespace through the check also satisfies the "blank" half of the spec for `address`/`city`, which the existing pattern/size validation would otherwise let through.
